title: Canon bundle (export/bundle.json)
description: Everything in one file for single-fetch injection into prompts, evals and tools that cannot read a folder: the parsed contract plus every canonical page with its status, owner and citation URL. Generated by the sync, never edited. Reference: docs/formats.md section 5.
$comment: The contract is embedded as a plain object rather than referenced by $ref so this file can be validated standalone: the sync has already validated the contract against context-contract.schema.json or client-context-contract.schema.json, and a bundle may carry either. A page the sync could not read is present with available: false and an empty markdown body, so a consumer iterating the bundle sees the gap. Prompt builders should inject only pages whose status the contract allows (grounded, and draft only with the unconfirmed label) and should cite each page's url.

generated_at.description: Same clock as meta.json.generated_at: when the exported content last changed. A prompt that embeds the bundle should state it ('canon as of ...').

last_synced_at.description: Optional copy of the heartbeat clock from meta.json for consumers that only fetch the bundle.

contract_version.description: Optional copy of the contract version for consumers that only fetch the bundle.

source_of_truth.description: Optional copy of the contract's source_of_truth.

content_hash.description: Optional digest over the bundle's pages, matching meta.json.content_hash when both are present.

contract.description: The parsed contract, verbatim, with dates serialised as ISO strings. Agents read instruction_authority and rules from here rather than from a separate file, so the bundle is self-governing.

pages.description: Every canonical page keyed by slug, in contract order. Keys match contract.canonical_pages exactly; the sync fails when a slug is missing here and absent from meta.json.pages_missing.

isoDateTime.description: An RFC 3339 timestamp with explicit offset; the sync writes UTC with a Z suffix.

title.description: Human title of the page as it appears in the source. Display only; agents resolve pages by slug and id, never by title.

status.description: Status copied from the contract at export time. Governs use: grounded may be asserted and cited; draft only when labelled unconfirmed; stub is never loaded as truth; deprecated is not used.

owner.description: The owner ROLE from the contract (owner in a business contract, owner_role in a client contract; the sync normalises both to owner here).

review.description: Review cadence copied from the contract.

url.description: Citation URL: page_url_base + page id. This is the string agents put after a claim so a reader can check it.

available.description: false when the sync could not read the page on this run; the entry is kept so consumers notice the gap. When false, markdown is empty and the slug is listed in meta.json.pages_missing.

markdown.description: The page body as markdown, prefixed with the generated header (source, slug, status, owner, generated_at, caveat). Empty string when available is false.

visibility.description: Optional: the page's visibility, copied so an embedding job can filter pages without re-reading the contract.

caveat.description: Optional: the caveat string for the status (for example 'grounded: may be asserted and cited'), the same text the generated header carries.

source_id.description: Optional: the page id or path in the source system, useful when url is not resolvable offline.

last_reviewed.description: Optional: last_reviewed from the page frontmatter, when the source carries one.

next_review.description: Optional: next_review from the page frontmatter; the sync warns when it is in the past.
